mirror.answer: Neither opal-assets-ingest-mirror nor opal-assets-silver-orion failed on positions; both did what they are built to do, and the stall is upstream of them. The raw positions files for 09-28 and 09-29 never existed in opal-data-inf (only coerced .parquet, which the mirror refuses by ruling 16), which alone explains the silence for those two dates. It does not explain 09-30: that raw landed at 15:18:55Z, after the mirror's daily INF fire at 13:05Z, and the mirror is polling-only (next fire 2026-10-01 13:05Z), so 09-30 is also not yet mirrored for a second, independent reason; the silver-orion sweep at 16:00Z correctly found nothing missing in the monolith bronze. Separately, the mirror's eclipse row raises ALIEN SURPLUS on every INF invocation (after the orion row has copied), which fails each run but does not block positions. Proposed repair, not performed, is in the repair field.

(2) 09-30: the 13:05Z invocation (log stream 2026/09/30/[$LATEST]2dddeb92..., DENOMINATOR orion/inflection enumerated 9739 written 1, which is assets 2026-09-30 only) ran about 2h13m before the positions raw existed; there is no trigger between a raw landing in opal-data-inf and the next daily poll (polling design, lambda_function.py docstring), so the object is not yet mirrored. The opal-assets-silver-orion S3 trigger (orion/inflection/bronze/ *.jsonl.gz) fires only on a monolith write, and its 16:00Z sweep (cron(0 16 * * ? *), log 09-30T16:00:46Z) reports set_identity missing=0 against what is in the monolith bronze (expected 4940, matched 4940), so it had nothing to convert. silver-orion logs only START/END/REPORT because lambda_entry prints nothing on the happy path; its evidence is the manifests meta/conversions/20260930T160043Z-bcc6c8dc.json (sweep) and 20260930T130528Z-f6adc5e8.json (event, converted 1: assets/2026-09-30). Conclusion on the W97-S4 question: the missing 09-28/09-29 raw alone explains the silence for those two dates; it does NOT explain 09-30, whose raw exists but was not yet mirrored for the timing reason above, so 09-30 also stalled, for a second independent reason. Side findings, not causes of the silence: the mirror eclipse row raises ALIEN SURPLUS on eclipse/inflection/bronze/eclipse_membership_map/date=2026-09-24/{manifest.json,membership_map.json} (written 2026-09-25T15:40:03Z, not a mirrored key) on every INF invocation, after the orion row is already processed, so it fails the invocation and triggers two async retries (13:05, 13:06, 13:08Z) but does not block the orion copy; and the silver sweep verdict is FAIL every day on one alien key orion/inflection/silver/fact_assets/date=2026-08-06/data.parquet (landed 4941 vs expected 4940), which does not stop conversion.
mirror.repair: Proposed, NOT performed. (a) To land 09-30 now: invoke opal-assets-ingest-mirror once with {"firm":"inf"} (idempotent size-skip); the orion row copies bronze/positions/2026-09-30.jsonl.gz and the existing S3 notification triggers opal-assets-silver-orion, which writes silver/fact_positions/date=2026-09-30; otherwise it self-heals at the 2026-10-01 13:05Z fire. The eclipse ALIEN raise comes after the orion row, so it does not block. (b) 09-28 and 09-29 need the raw produced: re-run data/inf/manual_api/pull_inflection_positions_daily.py --start 2026-09-28 --end 2026-09-29 --upload-bronze (the endpoint takes the date in the path, see the asof section; an Orion call, so it needs its own authorization), and find why the scheduled producer wrote only .parquet on those dates; until then those dates are honest holes by ruling 16. (c) Mirror hygiene: classify eclipse_membership_map/ as a known non-mirror class in _assert_landed_membership (lambda_function.py:221-268) or move the two keys to their owner's prefix, so the INF invocation stops raising daily; this needs a CTO ruling because the mirror map is born with three rows and never grows. (d) To close the lag structurally, re-time the mirror after the raw positions producer or add a second INF fire; a schedule change, out of this cell.

asof.answer: YES, from the repo's documentation of the endpoint. The positions feed is GET /api/v1/Portfolio/Clients/{clientId}/Assets/{MM-DD-YYYY}?$top=50000&includeCostBasis=false: the date is a path segment, so an as-of date is accepted per call. The pull script takes --date, --backfill-days and --start/--end and formats each date with strftime('%m-%d-%Y') (pull_inflection_positions_daily.py:376, route at :71). The probe docstring records that DIAGFIX.009-NEW Phase 1 (commit 91da4d6a1) confirmed the endpoint supports arbitrary historical dates with real per-date currentValue, and probe_positions_mv_daily.py:382-426 is the historical-date probe (verdict HISTORICAL_DATES_SUPPORTED when every queried date returns 200 with rows). The portfolio DOMAIN.md calls it a snapshot endpoint returning the asset list as of {date}. Caveat from data/_contracts/vendor_asof_registry.yaml:112-122: asOfDate in the payload echoes the request, but the value vintage is the prior settled trading day (run-date-echo-of-prior-settled, label_offset -1 trading day). pull_inflection_positions.py is a different surface (Reporting scope by entityIds, no as-of path date). Not established: no document proves a call for 2026-09-28 or 09-29 would return data, only that arbitrary historical dates were supported when probed in April 2026. I made no Orion call.
